replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design states refresh token in plain app storage; concrete theft-to-takeover attack."},{"id":"T2","keep":false,"reason":"Same stolen-refresh-token-to-valid-session attack and harm as T1.","duplicateOf":"T1"},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Design has Face ID login as screen unlock only; distinct local-access enrollment attack."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Token persists after single password login; persistence/revocation gap is a distinct harm."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Biometric decision local only; backend lacks evidence, distinct dispute/repudiation harm."}]}
